source_block.bori: BORI CE Āraṇyaka Parva 3.1–3.3, Debroy vol. 3: brāhmaṇas follow the Pandavas into exile; Dhaumya teaches the Sūrya hymn; Sūrya gives Yudhishthira a copper vessel — the four kinds of food are inexhaustible until Draupadī has eaten. The Durvāsā visit is NOT in the constituted text (vulgate-only; CE apparatus), so Debroy has no chapter for beats boon→wide-gold.
source_block.gita_press: Gita Press Gorakhpur Mahābhārata, Vana Parva: adhyāya 3 (Sūrya’s tāmra piṭhara; food ends when Pāñcālī eats, ślokas ~72–73, 84); Draupadīharaṇa-parva, Durvāsā-upākhyāna adhyāya 262 (Duryodhana hosts Durvāsā, sends him to Yudhiṣṭhira) and 263 (the visit, Draupadī’s prayer, Śrīkṛṣṇa eats the particle, the sages depart). Online digitisations number these one higher; colophon numbering used here.
source_block.ganguli: K.M. Ganguli, Vana Parva: Aranyaka Parva Section III (copper vessel); Draupadi-harana Parva Section CCLX (Duryodhana’s boon: visit after the princess of Panchala has eaten) and Section CCLXI (Durvasa with ten thousand disciples; ablutions; Draupadi’s prayer; Krishna hungry; particle of rice and vegetable at the rim; sages sated in the stream flee; Bhima finds the bank empty; Krishna departs).
source_block.divergence: (1) CE vs vulgate: BORI CE excludes the Durvāsā episode; Gita Press and Ganguli (vulgate) carry it in full and agree beat for beat. (2) Vessel: all three say copper (tāmra); the series paints burnished copper-gold (shipped lock) — stylisation only. (3) Washing: Ganguli says only that Draupadi had eaten and was resting; scouring on plate-empty is a gloss that changes no causality. (4) Ending: the earlier Ep04 cut said the sages ‘bless the Pandavas and turn back, content’ ‘far away’ — the texts have them sated in the nearby river and fleeing in fear of the Pandavas’ wrath (Durvasa recalls Ambarisha); rewrite follows the texts. (5) Earlier cut gave no cause for the visit; Duryodhana’s boon (Ganguli CCLX / Gita Press 262) is restored as its own beat.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press + BORI overlap where the CE covers the event (exile, Sūrya’s vessel and its rule — Āraṇyaka 3.3 / Gita Press Vana 3); for the CE-absent Durvāsā episode, Gita Press Gorakhpur (Vana 262–263) as primary with Ganguli CCLX–CCLXI for English wording. Each beat cites ≥2 of the three; Durvāsā beats cite Gita Press + Ganguli and record the BORI gap explicitly.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology Durvasa (fierce, never photoreal horror). Duryodhana in court dress (Ep 08 lock), never battle armor here. Krishna = Ep 09 look lock. Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or any finished plate as an Imagine ref.

sources.cite: Gita Press Gorakhpur, Vana Parva, Draupadīharaṇa-parva, Durvāsā-upākhyāna, adhyāya 263 (close): Bhīma finds no one; Śrīkṛṣṇa consoles the Pandavas and takes leave

K.M. Ganguli, Vana Parva, Draupadi-harana Parva, Section CCLXI (261) (close): Bhima, sent by Krishna to invite the sages, finds the bank deserted; Krishna reassures the Pandavas and departs for Dvaraka

BORI CE / Debroy — NOT in the constituted Āraṇyaka text: the Durvāsā episode survives only in vulgate manuscripts (CE apparatus), so Debroy’s translation has no chapter for it; recorded as a gap, not a cite

plates.audit_notes: 2026-10-01 rewrite (logic + sources pass, Ep 14 standard): causal chain Surya's vessel rule → Duryodhana's boon → timed visit → prayer → Krishna's hunger → grain → sages full at the river and flee → trap closes on nothing.
plates.source_divergence: Text: copper vessel (tāmra sthālī / tāmra piṭhara, BORI 3.3 + Gita Press 3.3 + Ganguli III). Series paints it burnished copper-gold with divine glow (shipped akshayapatra-bowl-v2 lock) — accepted stylisation, not a plot change.
plates.chosen: Gita Press + BORI overlap on the vessel rule (inexhaustible until Draupadī eats); keep the shipped copper-gold bowl lock; prompts say ‘burnished copper-gold’ on any future regen.

prop_continuity.vessel: Burnished copper-gold wide circular ceremonial bowl, two curved side handles, short pedestal foot, lotus petal engraving, soft divine glow. Medium-large. NEVER a U-ring, bangle, or plain cookpot. (Text: copper — see source_block.divergence.)
